steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Will the asset type used in the setCurrentTilemap function display a tilemap?


Solution:

The asset type in the setCurrentTilemap function should be changed from tile to tilemap.


Ask the ninja:

❓ Which image asset should be used for the pictureFrame sprite?


Solution:

The asset name should be changed from ‘picture’ to ‘pictureFrame’ in sprites.create function.


Ask the ninja:

❓ Where can the coordinates of the shelf tiles be found in the tilemap editor?


Solution:

The tilemap coordinates in the crystallBall, hat, and milkCarton sprites.create code should be changed to something between: 1-8 (column) and (1) or (3) (row)
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working tilemap project!


A tilemap asset should be displayed on screen. 


The pictureFrame sprite should appear on the bookcase.


Each sprite should be correctly placed on a shelf tile when the project begins.


Use the functions in the code menu, the debug tool, and the code completion tool to create a working version of this tilemap project!

subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about using the Assets menu to create and manage assets in a project, including tilemaps. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: Asset Management

badges.title: Carefully Curated

badges.title: Art Re-Collecting

badges.title: Drop a Pin
